meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: Claude 会补齐接入 Telegram 所需的代码并验证；再引导你通过 @BotFather 建机器人、填入令牌；接着重启服务并给出 4 位配对码，你发给机器人即完成绑定，机器人会发来问候。
howto.when: 当你想把 Telegram 作为 NanoClaw 的聊天入口时——比如在配置向导里选 Telegram，或直接说“接入 Telegram”——这个技能便会接手。

say.text: 把 Telegram 接到我这个 NanoClaw 上。
say.note: 它会先补齐接入代码并引导下一步。

say.text: 我要用 Telegram 机器人连上 NanoClaw，开始吧。
say.note: 会引导你建机器人、填令牌并配对。

say.text: 帮我完成 Telegram 的配对验证。
say.note: 把出现的 4 位配对码发给机器人即可。

howto.what_en: Claude adds Telegram support to the project and verifies it. Then it guides you to create a bot via @BotFather, enter the token, restart, and send the 4-digit code shown to the bot to pair the channel.
howto.when_en: Activates when you want Telegram as a NanoClaw chat channel—for example, when you pick Telegram in the setup wizard or ask to connect a Telegram bot.

say_en.text: Add Telegram to this NanoClaw project as a chat channel.
say_en.note: It starts the integration and guides the next steps.

say_en.text: I want to connect a Telegram bot to NanoClaw — start now.
say_en.note: Walks you through bot creation, token entry, and pairing.

say_en.text: Help me run the Telegram pairing verification.
say_en.note: Send the 4-digit code to the bot to complete pairing.
